usageNotes: Returns the directory index of APT sub-endpoints available under a given PDM node (e.g. update, changelog, versions). Use this to discover which package-management operations are exposed for a node before calling them. No special privilege is required, but the target node must be online and reachable by PDM.

examples.summary: List available APT sub-endpoints for node 'pdm-node1'

tips: The response is a link/directory index, not package data — follow up with sibling endpoints like get_nodes_node_apt_update or get_nodes_node_apt_versions to retrieve actionable information.
This endpoint is safe to call at any time; it is read-only and has no side effects.
